indicator_name: Loans to the economy by creditor type (banks, other public sector, microfinance, mortgage companies), currency and borrower
description: Кредиты экономике по типу кредитора (банки, прочий госсектор, МФО, ипотечные организации), валюте и заёмщику
methodology: NBK formId=445, stocks at report_date (the first day of the month after the reference month, like the scalar LOANS_* series). Quarterly 2022-01…2023-07, monthly from 2023-07. Item = CREDITOR.CURRENCY.BORROWER; OPS = «other public sector» (state development institutions); BANKS.KZT.BUS equals the scalar LOANS_BUSINESS_KZT. OPS.FX.BUS appears from 2025-06, OPS.FX.HH only in 2026-07. By 17.10.2026 the NBK renamed «other public sector» to «Other public sector entities» over the whole history (values unchanged); both names map to OPS.
